notes: The first declared kappa of 1e6 N/m made the initial implicit step try to close the 0.55 m torso seams in one frame; the resulting CCD sweep volumes exhausted GPU memory and crashed the contact broad phase.

This one declared change (soft assembly kappa 100 N/m) bounds the approach speed so panels glide around the collider under contact instead of teleporting; the closed-seam equilibrium force stays zero because the rest length is zero.

Rest-length-zero stitches require sewn panel pairs to reach zero separation, so contact between each distinct sewn panel pair is disabled; cloth self-collision and cloth-collider contact stay enabled.
Contact offsets are declared below the smallest staged separations: the front-torso center-front seam starts 0.78 mm apart and the staged collar sits 0.59 mm from the collider.
The shell mass calibration keeps the plan's 0.001 m thickness; the contact offset attribute is set separately to the declared values.

convergence.rule: a phase ends early when every stitch group active in that phase stays under the separation threshold for the declared consecutive frame count

determinism.rule: two clean runs with identical inputs must agree per vertex within the declared deviation

cloth.moduliAdaptation: StrainLimitingBaraffWitkinShell takes one isotropic ElasticModuli2D; the declared moduli use the calibration stretch Young's modulus with the calibration Poisson ratio. Combining the separate 600 Pa shear value through youngs_shear() implies Poisson 49 and a negative Lame lambda, which destroys the material.

revisionNote: Plan v3's verification measured 1,494 garment self-intersections, all of them between sewn panel pairs whose mutual contact the executor had disabled wholesale. With the body-frame staging, every sewn pair except the two coincident collar assembly pairs stages outside the contact envelope, so contact now stays enabled for sewn pairs and a seam rests at the mutual thickness sum, which still passes every declared seam gate. Only pairs whose staged separation sits inside the envelope keep disabled contact.
